project_title: Variations in gut microbial profiles in ankylosing spondylitis: disease phenotype-related dysbiosis.
project_description: Case-control study of 41 ankylosing spondylitis patients (20 axial, 21 peripheral) versus 19 healthy controls using 16S rRNA V4 fecal sequencing with LEfSe analysis.
citation: Chen et al. 2019, Annals of Translational Medicine, PMID 31807552
notes: Paper reports SILVA clade labels 'Prevotella_9' and 'Prevotella_2' as separately enriched in AS; collapsed here to the parent genus Prevotella. Single row represents both SILVA clades. Cohort is diagnosed AS (1984 modified New York criteria), not undifferentiated SpA. HLA-B27 positive in 19/20 axial AS (95%) and 21/21 peripheral AS (100%). Patients free of csDMARDs, corticosteroids and biological agents for >=3 months before sampling. LEfSe with Kruskal-Wallis and FDR correction; no per-genus LDA score stated verbatim in text, so lda_score left blank.

project_title: Integration of Metabolomics and 16S Ribosomal RNA Sequencing to Elucidate the Pathogenesis of Ankylosing Spondylitis.
project_description: Case-control study of 40 ankylosing spondylitis patients versus 40 age- and sex-matched healthy controls using 16S rRNA V3-V4 fecal sequencing with LEfSe analysis.
citation: Wang et al. 2025, Immunity Inflammation and Disease, PMID 40143557
notes: Cohort is diagnosed AS (1984 modified New York criteria), not undifferentiated SpA. HLA-B27 positive in 36/40 (90%). No glucocorticoids, antibiotics, csDMARDs, bDMARDs or tsDMARDs in the prior 3 months; all patients were NSAID-treated with poor response (authors flag NSAID use as a residual confounder). LEfSe with logarithmic LDA threshold 2.0 and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction; no per-genus LDA score stated verbatim, so lda_score left blank.

project_title: Alterations in the Gut Microbiome in Ankylosing Spondylitis and Their Correlation with Disease Activity.
project_description: Case-control study of 44 ankylosing spondylitis patients versus 50 healthy controls using 16S rRNA V4 fecal sequencing with Wilcoxon rank-sum comparison and LEfSe analysis.
citation: Jeong et al. 2025, Journal of Microbiology and Biotechnology, PMID 41423295
notes: Verbatim: 'Escherichia, a member of Enterobacteriaceae, was significantly higher in the AS group (HC = 0.0%, AS = 1.9%, p = 0.034)'. LEfSe LDA score reported as >= 3.8 (lower bound only). Cohort is diagnosed AS. HLA-B27 status not reported for this cohort. 17/44 (38.6%) of AS patients were receiving anti-TNF agents at sampling (no anti-IL-17 use) - treatment is an uncontrolled confounder. LEfSe LDA values are reported only as lower bounds (e.g. 'LDA score >= 3.8'), not exact scores, so lda_score is left blank and the bound recorded here. p-values are from Wilcoxon rank-sum tests and appear to be nominal (no FDR correction stated).
